name: Byron Donalds

pages.title: Byron Donalds for Congress
pages.text:
## A conservative fighter for Florida's 19th district.
Congressman Byron Donalds is a conservative leader who will bring the fight to the swamp creatures in Washington, DC. He's everything the fake news media says doesn't exist: a Trump supporting, liberty loving, pro-life, pro-2nd Amendment black man. That's what we need to drain the swamp.
Byron Donalds is a conservative champion for Southwest Florida. He has a proven record of banning sanctuary cities, fighting for taxpayers, and defending our constitutional rights. Raised by a single mom, Byron Donalds learned that anyone can achieve the American Dream with hard work. Byron has worked in the finance, insurance and banking industries in Southwest Florida. He worked as a partner in a local financial firm. While serving as a state legislator, Byron fought to clean our water, protect our seniors, expand school choice, and enact criminal justice reform. Byron Donalds lives in Naples, Florida with his wife Erika and their three sons.
## Endorsed by:
100% Rating from Florida Right to Life

pages.title: Foreign Policy - Byron Donalds for Congress
pages.text:
## Foreign Policy
A federal government actually responsible and held accountable to the people wouldn’t play political games, and wouldn’t allow petty politics to play a factor in decisions that involve the safety of our brave soldiers in the field of a battle. With my colleagues in Congress, I will work to bring an end to endless wars that cost taxpayers billions, and the ultimate sacrifice of our men and women in uniform.
To maintain our status as the #1 economy in the world, the federal government must create tax policy that allows American companies to compete freely and fairly with their foreign counterparts, while only regulating when absolutely necessary.
In Congress, I will stand strong against China and Russia as they attempt to expand their sphere of influence, and communism, on the world. Most importantly, I will work to assure America remains the leader of the free world and the voice of liberty across the globe.

## United States Federal Policy

As a nation, we must bring an end to endless wars that cost taxpayers millions, and the ultimate sacrifice of our men and women in uniform.
In order to compete with emerging foreign economies, our federal government must create tax policy that allows American companies to compete freely and fairly with their foreign counterparts, while only regulating when absolutely necessary.
As a nation, we must exert leadership in addressing the long-term threat of nuclear proliferation, especially the risk of Weapons of Mass Destruction and nuclear weapons winding up in the hands of terrorists. We must continue to stand strong against China and Russia as they attempt to expand their sphere of influence, and communism, on the world. Most importantly, as a nation, America must remain the leader of the free world and the voice of liberty across the globe.

pages.text:
Byron Donalds for Governor
## Fighting to defend
the Florida dream.
## The Plans for Florida
View All Issues
## Affordability
Florida cannot become too expensive for working families and seniors on fixed incomes. The status quo has a cost. Progress doesn't pay the bill sitting on your kitchen counter today—it's time to bring down costs.
## Healthcare
You deserve to know what healthcare costs before you get treated. Your Doctor, Your Price puts you back in charge, cuts out the red tape, and lets doctors focus on their patients.
## Economy
California passes heavy regulations. New York sends you the bill. Florida puts out the welcome mat. Bureaucratic delays shouldn't stop honest people from opening a business and earning a living.
## Education
Reading by third grade is a basic promise every child deserves. Every student should Read to Succeed, stay active and healthy, and have a debt-free route to a great-paying job.
## Law and Order
We must secure our borders, keep local neighborhoods safe, stop taxpayer handouts to illegal immigration, and keep deadly drugs off our streets.
## Space and Tech
Every American who walked on the Moon took off from Florida's coast. It's time to bring NASA home, build out our launchpads, and create thousands of high-paying jobs right here in Florida.
Meet Byron Donalds
## Proven Conservative
Fighter for Florida
A conservative warrior for Florida’s 19th Congressional District.
Born and raised in Brooklyn, New York, Byron Donalds is the product of a single-parent household. Throughout his life, his mother made every sacrifice possible to give him the best opportunity to live the American Dream. That philosophy his mother taught him, striving to leave future generations better than the current, is what leads him in his work, his home life, and as a Member of Congress.

pages.title: Education - Byron Donalds for Governor
pages.text:
## Education
“Reading by third grade is a basic promise every child deserves. Every student should Read to Succeed, stay active and healthy, and have a debt-free route to a great-paying job.”
## Read to Succeed (Early Literacy):
Train future teachers in proven phonics and reading science so every classroom teaches reading the right way.
Catch reading issues early in Kindergarten through 2nd grade, before children fall behind.
Provide free, state-funded tutoring for every 3rd grader struggling with reading.
Reward top-performing reading teachers with real bonus pay for getting results.
Bring back real books in the classroom instead of parking young kids in front of screens all day.
## LaunchPad Florida (Debt-Free Careers):
Connect high schools and community colleges with local businesses to offer paid apprenticeships in construction, advanced manufacturing, and defense.
Help young Floridians step straight into careers earning around $60,000 a year without taking on piles of student debt.
Students and businesses lead not government bureaucracy
## Personalized Success Plans for Every Student:
Every student gets a tailored success plan no later than 6th grade, with annual updates through graduation.
College, university, workforce/trade, military, entrepreneurship, and hybrid pathways are equally resourced and equally respected.
Families are co-authors, not bystanders. Annual plan reviews include parent conversations.
Internship, apprenticeship, and industry certification milestones are baked into each plan, not treated as add-ons.
Transparency for parents means schools are held accountable so that each student is receiving a plan to express their God-given talents. No more education factories or status quo.
## Strong Kids, Strong Florida (Physical Fitness):
Bring back the Presidential Fitness Test to build healthy habits and keep kids active throughout the school day.
Give mini-grants to schools that encourage regular daily recess and structured physical activity.
Send fitness scores straight home to mom and dad, keeping children's private health data out of state databases.
## Parental Rights and Classroom Focus:
Let education money follow the student so parents can choose the best school for their child.
Keep partisan political theories out of the classroom so schools focus strictly on the basics: reading, math, and science.
## Accountable, Achievable, Affordable!

pages.title: Affordability - Byron Donalds for Governor
pages.text:
## Affordability
“Florida cannot become too expensive for working families and seniors on fixed incomes. The status quo has a cost. Progress doesn't pay the bill sitting on your kitchen counter today—it's time to bring down costs.”
## Bring Down Your Insurance Bill:
Protect reforms and stop lawsuit abuse that jacks up rates for everyone, saving homeowners hundreds of dollars a year.
Lower costs by trimming down state fees when reserves are full so those extra dollars stay in your wallet. Pursue regulatory reforms that lower insurance premiums.
Reform the My Safe Florida Home program and other grants programs to fund real, storm-hardening upgrades that lower your annual premium the most.
Keep Citizens Insurance small so everyday drivers and homeowners never get hit with a surprise "hurricane tax" bill after a big storm.
Cut the red tape and slow permitting that make rebuilding a home after a storm needlessly expensive and drive up your insurance premiums.
## Hold Insurance Companies Accountable—Put Consumers First:
Create a simple online Scorecard where you can compare insurance companies side by side on price, how fast they pay claims, and how often they deny coverage.
Require insurers to report accurate data or pay real fines, keeping the tool free for taxpayers by having the insurance industry cover the cost.
## Protect Homeowners & Utility Payers:
Keep property taxes in check so seniors and working families aren't taxed out of their homes.
Stop giant industrial data centers from passing their massive electric and water bills onto everyday households.
## Accountable, Achievable, Affordable!

pages.title: Healthcare - Byron Donalds for Governor
pages.text:
## Healthcare
“You deserve to know what healthcare costs before you get treated. Your Doctor, Your Price puts you back in charge, cuts out the red tape, and lets doctors focus on their patients.”
## Upfront, Clear Cash Prices:
Require doctors and hospitals to post plain, guaranteed cash prices for the 50 most common medical tests and procedures.
## Best Price Guarantee:
Ensure everyday patients paying cash get the lowest discounted rate that the hospital gives to big insurance companies.
## No Out-of-Network Traps:
Let what you pay to an out-of-network doctor count directly toward your yearly insurance deductible.
## Fast Insurance Approvals:
Require insurance companies to approve common treatments within three days instead of letting paperwork delay your care.
## Cheaper Prescriptions:
Expose pharmacy middleman markups so prescription discounts get passed straight to you at the checkout counter.
## Accountable, Achievable, Affordable!

pages.title: Economy - Byron Donalds for Governor
pages.text:
## Economy
“California passes heavy regulations. New York sends you the bill. Florida puts out the welcome mat. Bureaucratic delays shouldn't stop honest people from opening a business and earning a living.”
## A Public Shot Clock on Permits:
Put every business, building, and road permit on an open state website with a ticking clock, forcing local offices to approve projects on time.
## Streamlined State Reviews:
Bring all major development permits under a single digital hub so job creators spend less time in lines and more time hiring workers.
## Specialized Business Courts:
Route complicated business lawsuits through specialized judges so commercial fights don't clog up everyday neighborhood courtrooms.
## Keep Florida Income-Tax Free:
Keep our state personal income tax at zero, make sure Tallahassee balances its books responsibly every single year, and cut taxes at every opportunity.
## Accountable, Achievable, Affordable!

pages.title: Law and Order - Byron Donalds for Governor
pages.text:
## Law and Order
“We must secure our borders, keep local neighborhoods safe, stop taxpayer handouts to illegal immigration, and keep deadly drugs off our streets.”
## No Taxpayer Handouts:
Cut off state funds, subsidies, and free perks that encourage illegal immigration into Florida.
## Enforce Workplace Rules:
Require every Florida business to use the E-Verify system so legal workers keep the jobs and wages they've earned.
## Remove Dangerous Criminals:
Coordinate state and local police directly with federal authorities to quickly deport noncitizens who commit crimes in our communities.
## Crack Down on Fentanyl:
Target drug cartels with heavy penalties and joint police task forces to take deadly fentanyl off Florida streets.
## Accountable, Achievable, Affordable!

pages.title: Space and Tech - Byron Donalds for Governor
pages.text:
## Space and Tech
“Every American who walked on the Moon took off from Florida's coast. It's time to bring NASA home, build out our launchpads, and create thousands of high-paying jobs right here in Florida.”
## Bring NASA Headquarters to Florida:
Work to move NASA headquarters and the Space Force Academy right to our Space Coast where the rockets actually launch.
## Fast-Track Space Hubs:
Pre-approve the top 10 industrial space manufacturing sites across the state so aerospace companies set up shop in Florida without delay.
## Hands-on Tech Training:
Train Florida high schoolers and college students to work as skilled aerospace welders, machinists, and launch technicians.
## Host the Space Race Summit:
Bring leading private aerospace innovators and engineers together to ensure Florida stays the world's top launchpad.
## Accountable, Achievable, Affordable!
